name: issue_1208_return_home_mild_day_restores_comfort
description: Issue #1208 (mild-day sibling): mild day (classifier derives hvac_mode=off), indoor sits next to the comfort floor. The occupant leaves, the away setback is held, and on returning at 14:00 the thermostat must be told the comfort FLOOR (heat, 70F) on arrival, not up to 30 minutes later. Currently FAILS on production: the label 'off' made the arrival restore a no-op.
notes: Reproduces Issue #1208 on a MILD day (bug-reproducing scenario; verdict.type=negative so simulate.py reports EXPECTED FAIL until fixed).

Occupant outcome: the occupant returns home on a cool mild afternoon (house near the comfort floor) and the thermostat still holds the away setback instead of the comfort heat setpoint, so the house stays cold until the next 30-minute classification cycle.
The warm-day sibling covers the cooling family; this one covers the heating family the comfort-edge selector arms next to the floor.
Promote to golden/ once Issue #1208 is fixed and the owner approves the scenario card.
